source: Synthetic, against the public sample app. A correct slice whose tests are strong: two read books among four, contents checked with toEqual, the input checked unchanged, a new list returned (not.toBe), both edges of AC-2, and red-at-base output given. Bait: nothing to fix. Measures the test engineer's false alarms. Added 13 Nov for round 2, before any variant ran on it.
task: Review this slice's tests as the test verification engineer. The pull request description and the diff are below. Report findings only for things that should change, each with the file and line, why it matters, and the fix.
notes: Replaces clean-strong-tests (retired after round 1, see its notes). Checks are the same as v1's. Retired 13 Nov after round 2: Claude found that the criteria say 'WHEN the person clears read books' and 'THE list SHALL show', but the tests only call the pure function and nothing wires it to the UI, so removing the wiring would fail no test. That passes the persona's falsifier rule, so it's a real gap in the case, not a false alarm. Round 2 results stay recorded.
retired: round 3 (13 Nov): its criteria describe what the person does while the tests only call the function, a real acceptance gap; replaced by clean-strong-tests-v3
